title: High-threshold magic state distillation with quantum quadratic residue codes
summary: We present applications of quantum quadratic residue codes in magic state distillation. This includes showing that existing codes which are known to distill magic states, like the $5$-qubit perfect code, the $7$-qubit Steane code, and the $11$-qutrit and $23$-qubit Golay codes, are equivalent to certain quantum quadratic residue codes.
